key_insight: ReproRepo turns real GitHub issue reports into scalable supervision for evaluating whether LLM agents can find reproducibility blockers in paper-code pairs.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical, reusable benchmark for measuring how well agentic LLM systems can support reproducibility auditing in large-scale research workflows.
method: Collected 1,149 recent ML papers from major conferences with linked repositories.
Used human-raised GitHub issues as naturally occurring labels for real reproducibility blockers.
Evaluated four frontier model-agent configurations on paper-repository pairs without requiring code execution.
evidence_signal: The best agent, Codex with GPT-5.5, found at least one semantically related human-reported blocker for about 90% of papers.
watch_item: Agents can identify the right semantic area, but exact localization of the blocker is still imperfect and may limit practical debugging use.
paper_title: ReproRepo: Scaling Reproducibility Audits with GitHub Repository Issues
